{{Capricorn}}
Capricorn 14 is the 42nd day of the year in the [[Gaian calendar]]. It is the 14th day of Capricorn, and it is a Sunday. It corresponds to ISO week 6, weekday 7.

Its informal Japanese name is 2宮14日.

On this day, [[Gaiad chapter 42|Chapter 42]] of the [[Gaiad]] is read.

To see structured data on this date see {{q|Q152062}}.

===Chapter summary===
From Vertebratus’ first spine and Rene’s unified body plan, vertebrates rose through Hemos’ great brain, red blood cells, and Haikus’ leap of faith. Denton brought the gift of teeth, honored in sacred dental rites. Conodon and Pterapsis embodied predation and defense, but catastrophe ended their age, ushering in the Ordovician. With centralized organs, blood, armor, and teeth, vertebrates refined complexity and resilience, carrying forward the legacy of faith, innovation, and survival.
